title: must / have to / should
recall: must va have to farqi? mustn't va don't have to farqi? should qachon?
formula: must: o'zim zarur deb bilaman / qat'iy; have to: tashqi qoida, majburiyat
mustn't = taqiqlangan; don't have to = shart emas (lekin mumkin)
should / ought to: maslahat; had better: aks holda yomon bo'ladi; need to / needn't

pairs.b: You don't have to park here.
I have to wear a uniform.

items.uz: Men onamga qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak. (o'zim shunday deb bilaman)
en: I must call my mum.
I must call my mother.
I have to wear a uniform at work.
You mustn't smoke here.
You must not smoke here.

items.uz: Ertaga erta turishing shart emas — dam olish kuni.
en: You don't have to get up early tomorrow — it's a day off.
You don't have to get up early tomorrow, it's a day off.
You don't need to get up early tomorrow — it's a holiday.
You should rest more.
You should get more rest.
You ought to rest more.
I had to work late yesterday.
Yesterday I had to work late.
I'll have to submit the report tomorrow.
I will have to hand in the report tomorrow.
You'd better hurry, or you'll be late.
You had better hurry or you'll be late.
You should see a doctor.
You should go to the doctor.
You ought to see a doctor.
Do we have to buy tickets?
Do we need to buy tickets?

items.uz: Siz bu yerda pul to'lashingiz shart emas.
en: You don't have to pay here.
You don't need to pay here.
Drivers must wear seat belts.
Drivers have to wear seat belts.

items.uz: U ko'p ishlamasligi kerak edi — kasal bo'lib qoldi.
en: He shouldn't have worked so much — he got ill.
He shouldn't have worked so hard; he got sick.
You must see this museum!
You must visit this museum!

items.uz: Menga yordam berishing shart emas edi, lekin rahmat.
en: You didn't have to help me, but thanks.
You didn't need to help me, but thank you.
You mustn't use your phone in the exam.
You can't use your phone during the exam.

items.uz: Men har kuni 30 ta so'z o'rganishim kerak.
en: I have to learn 30 words every day.
I must learn 30 words every day.
I need to learn 30 words every day.
You should tell him the truth.
You ought to tell him the truth.
I don't have to work today.
I don't need to work today.
We had to wait.

speak: Ishingizdagi 5 ta qoida: have to / don't have to / mustn't.
Do'stingizga 5 ta maslahat bering: should / had better.
Kecha nima qilishga majbur bo'ldingiz? (had to)
